basics.name: Harry (Shenghuan) Sun
basics.label: Senior Machine Learning Scientist
basics.summary: Senior ML Scientist at Intuitive Surgical and Adjunct Assistant Professor at UCSF. I build and deploy computer vision and multimodal AI systems for computational pathology, from research through production in regulated clinical settings.

work.name: Intuitive Surgical
work.summary: ROSE team. Developing AI systems for real-time computational pathology in a regulated medical setting.
highlights: Lead research, development, and deployment of computer vision models to support clinical decision-making and next-generation surgical workflows.
Work across large-scale pathology data, model validation, and production systems.

work.name: University of California, San Francisco
work.summary: Teaching and mentoring at the intersection of machine learning and biomedicine.
highlights: Taught the inaugural Foundations in Machine Learning course for the AI and Computational Drug Discovery and Development (AICD3) MS program.
Mentor graduate students on research projects in medical vision-language models.
Designed and delivered curriculum covering core machine learning concepts and applications in biomedical domains.

work.name: Ruby Robotics (acquired by Intuitive Surgical)
work.summary: Founding ML hire. Built the machine learning effort from the ground up until acquisition.
highlights: Led research, development, and deployment of computer vision models for computational pathology, including weakly supervised learning and large-scale image analysis.
Built end-to-end ML systems spanning data curation, annotation infrastructure, model training, and deployment for real-world clinical workflows.

work.name: Ruby Robotics
work.summary: Early engineering hire developing deep learning models for computational pathology.

work.name: University of California, San Francisco
work.summary: PhD research co-advised by Prof. Atul Butte (UCSF) and Prof. Ahmed Alaa (UC Berkeley EECS).
highlights: Developed deep learning frameworks for computational pathology, including DeepHeme for bone marrow cytomorphology classification.
Built multimodal models integrating pathology images and clinical data, including medical vision-language models (VLMs).
Applied large language models to extract information from 6M+ patients (100M+ clinical notes) for real-world evidence generation.
Publications in Nature Medicine, Science Translational Medicine, Circulation, Nature Communications, and NeurIPS.

work.name: Tsinghua University
work.summary: Visiting machine learning researcher in Beijing.

work.summary: Machine learning research at CASIA in Beijing.

courses: Advised by Dr. Atul Butte (UCSF) and Dr. Ahmed Alaa (UC Berkeley)
